lessons.title: Menene AI (Artificial Intelligence)?
lessons.summary: Ma'anar hankalin wucin gadi a sauki
lessons.content:
Artificial Intelligence (AI), ko hankalin wucin gadi, shine fasahar da ke bawa kwamfuta damar yin abubuwan da a da mutum kadai ke iya yi - kamar fahimtar magana, gane hoto, ko amsa tambayoyi. AI ba yana nufin kwamfuta tana da hankali kamar mutum ba; a maimakon haka, tana amfani da bayanai masu yawa da alkaluma (algorithms) domin gane sifa (pattern) da kuma bada amsa mai kama da wadda mutum zai bayar.

A yau, AI tana ko'ina: a wayoyinmu, a manhajojin sadarwa, har ma a bankunanmu. Sanin asalin abin da AI take shi ne matakin farko na fahimtar yadda za a yi amfani da ita cikin hikima.

quiz.question: Menene AI (Artificial Intelligence)?
options: Fasahar da ke bawa kwamfuta damar yin abubuwan da mutum kadai ke iya yi
quiz.explanation: AI fasaha ce da ke kwaikwayon iyawar mutum kamar fahimta da amsawa.

quiz.question: Shin AI tana da hankali daidai da na mutum?
options: A'a, tana amfani da bayanai da alkaluma domin gane sifa
AI ba ta da wani iyawa
quiz.explanation: AI ba ta da hankali kamar na mutum; tana amfani da bayanai da algorithms.

quiz.question: Ta ina AI ke koyon yadda za ta amsa?
options: Ta hanyar bayanai masu yawa da take koya daga su
Ba ta koyo, an riga an tsara mata komai
quiz.explanation: AI tana koyo daga bayanai masu yawa domin gane sifofi da bada amsa.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na amfani da AI a rayuwar yau da kullum?
quiz.explanation: Fahimtar magana (voice assistant) misali ne na yadda AI ke aiki a rayuwarmu.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar fahimtar asalin AI?
options: Domin a yi amfani da ita cikin hikima
Domin dole ne kowa ya zama injiniya
quiz.explanation: Fahimtar asali yana taimaka wa mutum yin amfani da AI cikin hikima da kariya.

diagram.caption: Ma'anar hankalin wucin gadi a sauki

lessons.title: Yadda AI Ke Aiki - Bayanai da Koyo
lessons.summary: Fahimtar yadda AI ke koyo daga bayanai
lessons.content:
AI tana aiki ta hanyar nazarin adadin bayanai (data) masu yawan gaske domin gane sifofi da alaka a tsakaninsu. Misali, idan aka nuna wa AI hotuna dubu na kyanwa da karnuka, sannu a hankali za ta iya koyon bambanci tsakanin su ta hanyar gane sifofi kamar siffar kunne ko fatar jiki.

Wannan tsari ana kiransa 'training' (horaswa). Bayan an horas da AI da isassun bayanai, za ta iya amfani da abin da ta koya domin yin hasashe ko amsa kan sabbin bayanai da ba ta taba gani ba a baya.

quiz.question: Ta yaya AI ke koyo?
options: Ta hanyar nazarin adadin bayanai masu yawa
quiz.explanation: AI tana koyo ta hanyar nazarin bayanai masu yawa domin gane sifofi.

quiz.question: Menene ake kira tsarin horas da AI da bayanai?
quiz.explanation: Training shine tsarin da ake amfani da bayanai domin koyar da AI.

quiz.question: Bayan an horas da AI, me za ta iya yi?
options: Ta yi hasashe ko amsa kan sabbin bayanai
quiz.explanation: Bayan training, AI za ta iya amfani da abin da ta koya kan sabbin bayanai.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na 'data' da za a iya horas da AI da shi?
options: Hotuna dubu na kyanwa da karnuka
quiz.explanation: Hotuna masu lamba (misali kyanwa/kare) misali ne na bayanan horaswa.

quiz.question: Menene AI ke gani a bayanai domin koyo?
options: Sifofi da alaka a tsakanin bayanan
quiz.explanation: AI tana gane sifofi da alaka domin fahimtar bayanai.

diagram.caption: Fahimtar yadda AI ke koyo daga bayanai

lessons.title: Misalan AI a Rayuwar Yau da Kullum
lessons.summary: Inda AI take aiki ba tare da mun sani ba
lessons.content:
AI tana kewaye da mu ko da ba mu sani ba. Google Maps tana amfani da AI domin ba da shawarar hanya mafi kyau. Netflix da YouTube suna amfani da AI domin ba ka shawarar bidiyo ko fina-finai bisa abin da ka saba kallo. Bankuna suna amfani da AI domin gano zamba a ma'amaloli.

Hatta wayarka, idan tana da fasalin gane fuska don bude waya, hakan ma AI ne. Sanin wadannan misalai yana taimaka mana fahimtar cewa AI ba wani abu ne mai nisa ba - tana cikin rayuwarmu ta yau da kullum.

quiz.question: Ta yaya Google Maps ke amfani da AI?
options: Domin ba da shawarar hanya mafi kyau
quiz.explanation: Google Maps tana amfani da AI domin nazarin zirga-zirga da ba da shawarar hanya.

quiz.question: Ta yaya Netflix/YouTube ke amfani da AI?
options: Domin ba da shawarar abin kallo bisa abin da ka saba
quiz.explanation: Suna amfani da AI domin ba da shawarwarin da suka dace da dandanon mai kallo.

quiz.question: Ta yaya bankuna ke amfani da AI?
quiz.explanation: AI tana taimaka wa bankuna gano ma'amaloli masu shakku ko zamba.

quiz.question: Menene misali na AI a wayar hannu?
options: Fasalin gane fuska don bude waya
quiz.explanation: Gane fuska (face unlock) misali ne na AI a wayar hannu.

quiz.question: Me darasin nan ke koya mana game da AI?
options: Tana ko'ina a rayuwarmu ta yau da kullum
Kwararru kadai ke amfani da ita
Tana da tsada sosai wajen amfani
quiz.explanation: AI tana cikin ayyuka da yawa da muke yi kullum ba tare da mu sani ba.

diagram.caption: Inda AI take aiki ba tare da mun sani ba

lessons.title: Chatbots da AI Assistants
lessons.content:
Chatbots na AI kamar ChatGPT, Claude, da Gemini manhajoji ne da ke iya yin magana da kai ta rubutu, suna amsa tambayoyi, taimaka wajen rubutu, ko bayar da bayani kan kusan kowane fanni. Ana kiran wadannan 'Language Models' (samfuran harshe) domin an horas da su akan adadin rubutu mai yawan gaske daga intanet da littattafai.

Wadannan kayan aiki suna da amfani sosai wajen taimakawa wajen aiki, karatu, da neman ra'ayi. Amma su ma suna da iyaka - ba koyaushe suke da gaskiya 100% ba, don haka ana bukatar tantance bayanansu, musamman kan muhimman al'amura.

quiz.question: Menene ChatGPT ko Claude?
options: Chatbot na AI da ke amsa tambayoyi ta rubutu
quiz.explanation: ChatGPT da Claude misalai ne na AI chatbots (language models).

quiz.question: Ta yaya ake kira wadannan kayan aiki na AI?
quiz.explanation: Ana kiransu Language Models domin an horas da su akan rubutu mai yawa.

quiz.question: Wanne amfani ne za a iya samu daga AI chatbot?
options: Taimako wajen rubutu da neman bayani
quiz.explanation: AI chatbots suna taimakawa wajen rubutu, karatu, da neman bayani.

quiz.question: Shin bayanin da AI chatbot ke bayarwa gaskiya ne 100%?
options: A'a, wani lokaci na iya zama kuskure, don haka ana bukatar tantancewa
quiz.explanation: AI chatbots na iya kuskure wani lokaci, don haka tantance bayani yana da muhimmanci.

quiz.question: A kan me aka horas da AI language models?
options: Adadin rubutu mai yawa daga intanet da littattafai
quiz.explanation: Language models suna koyo daga rubutu mai yawan gaske.

lessons.title: Yadda Ake Rubuta Umarni Mai Kyau (Prompting)
lessons.summary: Fasahar tambayar AI don samun amsa mai kyau
lessons.content:
Prompting shine fasahar rubuta tambaya ko umarni ga AI ta yadda za ka samu amsa mafi kyau. Maimakon rubuta tambaya gajarta kamar 'Ka rubuta mani wasika', zai fi kyau ka bayar da cikakken bayani: wanene za a rubuta wa, menene manufar wasikar, da kuma irin salon da ake so.

Misali, maimakon 'Ka koya mani AI', zai fi kyau a ce 'Ka koya mani menene AI a takaice, kamar dai ina bayani ga wanda bai taba jin labarinsa ba'. Yadda ka bayyana tambayarka yana da matukar tasiri kan ingancin amsar da AI za ta bayar.

quiz.question: Menene prompting?
options: Fasahar rubuta tambaya ga AI don samun amsa mai kyau
quiz.explanation: Prompting shine yadda ake tsara tambaya ga AI don samun amsa mai amfani.

quiz.question: Me yasa ya fi kyau a bayar da cikakken bayani a tambayar AI?
options: Domin AI za ta ba da amsa mafi kyau da ta dace da bukatarka
Domin AI ba za ta fahimta ba tare da haka
quiz.explanation: Cikakken bayani yana taimaka wa AI fahimtar ainihin abin da kake bukata.

quiz.question: Wanne tambaya ce mafi kyau ga AI?
options: Ka koya mani menene AI a takaice, kamar ina bayani ga wanda bai taba ji ba
quiz.explanation: Cikakkiyar tambaya mai bayani na musamman takan bada amsa mafi dacewa.

quiz.question: Me ke da tasiri kan ingancin amsar AI?
options: Yadda ka bayyana ko tsara tambayarka
quiz.explanation: Tsari da bayanin da ke cikin tambayarka yana shafar ingancin amsar.

quiz.question: Wanne bayani ne zai taimaka wa AI ta rubuta wasika mai kyau a madadinka?
options: Wanene za a rubuta wa da manufar wasikar
quiz.explanation: Bayani kan mai karba da manufa yana taimaka wa AI bada sakamako mai dacewa.

diagram.caption: Fasahar tambayar AI don samun amsa mai kyau

lessons.title: Iyakokin AI
lessons.summary: Abin da AI ba za ta iya yi da kyau ba tukuna
lessons.content:
Ko da yake AI tana da amfani sosai, tana da iyaka. Wani lokaci AI na iya bada amsa da take kama da gaskiya amma ba gaskiya ba ce - ana kiran wannan 'hallucination'. Saboda haka, kada ka amince da AI 100% akan muhimman al'amura kamar likita ko shari'a ba tare da tabbatarwa daga kwararre ba.

Haka kuma, AI na iya nuna son zuciya (bias) idan bayanan da aka horas da ita da su suna da son zuciya. Fahimtar wadannan iyakoki yana taimaka mana yin amfani da AI cikin hikima, ba tare da dogaro da ita gaba ɗaya ba.

quiz.question: Menene 'hallucination' a AI?
options: Lokacin da AI ta bada amsa kama da gaskiya amma ba gaskiya ba
quiz.explanation: Hallucination shine lokacin da AI ke bada amsa marar gaskiya amma mai kama da gaskiya.

quiz.question: Me yasa bai kamata a amince da AI 100% akan muhimman al'amura ba?
options: Domin tana iya yin kuskure ko hallucination
Domin ba ta da wani amfani
quiz.explanation: AI na iya yin kuskure, don haka ana bukatar tabbatarwa daga kwararre kan muhimman al'amura.

quiz.question: Menene 'bias' a AI?
options: Son zuciya da AI ke nunawa saboda bayanan da aka horas da ita
quiz.explanation: Bias yana faruwa idan bayanan horaswa suna dauke da son zuciya.

quiz.question: Wanne fanni ne ya kamata a tabbatar da AI ta hanyar kwararre kafin aiki da amsarta?
quiz.explanation: Fannonin da suka shafi rayuwa ko doka na bukatar tabbaci daga kwararru.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata mu yi da sanin iyakokin AI?
options: Mu yi amfani da ita cikin hikima ba tare da dogaro gaba ɗaya ba
Mu daina amfani da ita gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Fahimtar iyakoki yana taimaka mana amfani da AI cikin hikima.

diagram.caption: Abin da AI ba za ta iya yi da kyau ba tukuna

lessons.title: Nau'ukan AI - Narrow AI da General AI
lessons.summary: Bambanci tsakanin AI na musamman da AI mai cikakken hankali
lessons.content:
Yawancin AI da muke amfani da su a yau 'Narrow AI' ne (AI mai iyakantaccen hankali) - suna iya yin aiki ɗaya kacal da kyau sosai, kamar fassara harshe ko gane hoto, amma ba za su iya tunani a fannoni daban-daban kamar mutum ba.

'General AI' (ko AGI - Artificial General Intelligence) wani AI ne mai hasashe wanda zai iya yin tunani da koyo a kowane fanni kamar yadda mutum yake yi, amma har yanzu ba a kai wannan matakin ba a duniya. Fahimtar wannan bambanci yana taimaka wajen sanin abin da AI ta yau take iya yi da abin da take iya yi a nan gaba.

quiz.question: Menene Narrow AI?
options: AI mai iyakantaccen hankali wanda ke iya yin aiki ɗaya kacal da kyau
AI mai hankali kamar mutum a kowane fanni
quiz.explanation: Narrow AI tana kware a aiki ɗaya kacal, kamar fassara ko gane hoto.

quiz.question: Menene AGI (General AI)?
options: AI mai hasashe wanda zai iya tunani a kowane fanni kamar mutum
quiz.explanation: AGI shine ra'ayin AI mai iya tunani a kowane fanni kamar mutum.

quiz.question: Shin an riga an kai matakin AGI a duniya?
options: A'a, har yanzu ba a kai wannan matakin ba
Ba shi da wani bambanci da Narrow AI
quiz.explanation: Har yanzu AGI ra'ayi ne kawai, ba a kai wannan matakin ba a fili.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na Narrow AI?
options: Mutum mai tunani a fannoni da yawa
quiz.explanation: App na fassara harshe misali ne na Narrow AI - kware a aiki ɗaya.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar sanin bambanci tsakanin Narrow AI da AGI?
options: Domin sanin abin da AI ta yau take iya yi da abin da za ta iya yi nan gaba
Domin dole ne a zama injiniya
quiz.explanation: Wannan fahimta tana taimaka wa mutane fahimtar iyakokin AI ta yanzu.

diagram.caption: Bambanci tsakanin AI na musamman da AI mai cikakken hankali

lessons.title: Machine Learning - Menene Shi?
lessons.summary: Bayani kan yadda injuna ke koyo daga bayanai
lessons.content:
Machine Learning (ML) wani bangare ne na AI wanda ke bawa kwamfuta damar koyo daga bayanai ba tare da an tsara mata kowane mataki na musamman ba. Akwai nau'i biyu na gama-gari: 'Supervised Learning' (inda ake bayar da bayanai tare da amsoshin da suka dace, sannan AI ta koyi alaka tsakaninsu) da 'Unsupervised Learning' (inda ake bayar da bayanai ba tare da amsa ba, sai AI ta gano sifofi da kanta).

Misali na Supervised Learning shine bayar da hotuna dubu na kyanwa da karnuka tare da sunayensu domin AI ta koyi bambancewa. Machine Learning shine tushen yawancin fasahar AI da muke amfani da su a yau.

quiz.question: Menene Machine Learning?
options: Bangare na AI da ke koyo daga bayanai
quiz.explanation: Machine Learning yana bawa kwamfuta damar koyo daga bayanai.

quiz.question: Menene Supervised Learning?
options: Koyo ta amfani da bayanai tare da amsoshin da suka dace
Koyo ba tare da wani bayani ba
quiz.explanation: Supervised Learning yana amfani da bayanai masu lamba (amsoshi) domin koyarwa.

quiz.question: Menene Unsupervised Learning?
options: Koyo ta amfani da bayanai ba tare da amsa ba, AI ta gano sifofi da kanta
Koyo tare da amsoshin da suka dace kawai
quiz.explanation: A Unsupervised Learning, AI take gano sifofi da kanta ba tare da an bayar da amsa ba.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na Supervised Learning?
options: Bayar da hotunan kyanwa da karnuka tare da sunayensu
Barin AI ta yi tunani ba tare da wani bayani ba
quiz.explanation: Wannan misali ne na koyo tare da amsoshin da suka dace (labeled data).

quiz.question: Menene Machine Learning ke zama tushensa ga yawancin fasahar AI?
options: Gaskiya ne - ML shine tushen yawancin fasahar AI ta yau
Karya ne, ML ba shi da alaka da AI
ML da AI iri ɗaya ne gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Machine Learning shine tushen da yawancin fasahar AI ta yau ke ginu a kai.

lessons.title: Manyan Kayan Aikin AI na Yau
lessons.summary: Sanin kayan aikin AI da ake amfani da su a rayuwar aiki
lessons.content:
Akwai kayan aikin AI da yawa da za a iya amfani da su a yau don ayyuka daban-daban: ChatGPT da Claude don rubutu da tattaunawa, Midjourney da DALL-E don kirkirar hotuna daga rubutu, Otter.ai don rubuta abin da aka fada a taro, da Grammarly don gyara nahawun rubutu.

Haka kuma, akwai AI da aka hada a cikin manhajoji da muke amfani da su kullum, kamar Microsoft Excel (domin nazarin bayanai) da Google Photos (domin gane fuska da rarraba hotuna). Sanin wadannan kayan aiki yana bude kofa ga hanyoyi da yawa na inganta aiki da karatu.

quiz.question: Wanne kayan aiki ne ake amfani da shi don kirkirar hotuna daga rubutu?
quiz.explanation: Midjourney da DALL-E kayan aiki ne na AI da ke kirkirar hotuna daga rubutu.

quiz.question: Wanne kayan aiki ne ake amfani da shi don gyara nahawun rubutu?
quiz.explanation: Grammarly AI ne da ke taimakawa wajen gyara nahawu da rubutu.

quiz.question: Menene Otter.ai ke yi?
options: Yana rubuta abin da aka fada a taro
quiz.explanation: Otter.ai yana amfani da AI domin sauya magana zuwa rubutu.

quiz.question: Ta yaya Excel ke amfani da AI?
options: Domin nazarin bayanai da ba da shawarwari
quiz.explanation: Excel na amfani da AI wajen nazarin bayanai da bada shawarwarin gani (visualization).

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar sanin wadannan kayan aiki?
options: Domin su bude kofa ga hanyoyin inganta aiki da karatu
Domin dole ne a zama injiniya
quiz.explanation: Sanin kayan aiki daban-daban yana bunkasa yadda mutum ke aiki da karatu.

diagram.caption: Sanin kayan aikin AI da ake amfani da su a rayuwar aiki

lessons.title: Amfani da AI Wajen Aiki da Karatu
lessons.summary: Yadda ake amfani da AI don kara yawan aiki
lessons.content:
AI za ta iya taimaka wajen ayyuka da yawa: rubuta email na farko, takaita dogon rubutu zuwa gajeren bayani, samar da ra'ayoyi don aikin sabo, ko bayyana wani darasi mai wuya cikin sauki. Amma mafi kyawun amfani shine yin amfani da AI a matsayin mataimaki, ba wanda zai maye gurbin tunaninka gaba ɗaya ba.

Misali, dan kasuwa zai iya amfani da AI wajen tsara jadawalin kasuwanci, dalibi kuma zai iya amfani da ita wajen samar da tambayoyin gyara don shirya jarabawa. A kowace hali, ya kamata a duba amsar AI da kyau kafin a amince da ita gaba ɗaya.

quiz.question: Wanne aiki ne AI za ta iya taimaka a kai?
options: Takaita dogon rubutu zuwa gajeren bayani
quiz.explanation: Takaitawa (summarization) na ɗaya daga cikin amfanin AI mai muhimmanci.

quiz.question: Menene mafi kyawun hanyar amfani da AI?
options: A matsayin mataimaki, ba wanda zai maye gurbin tunaninka gaba ɗaya
A matsayin madadin tunani gaba ɗaya
Kada a taba amfani da ita
quiz.explanation: AI ta fi amfani a matsayin mataimaki maimakon a dogara mata gaba ɗaya.

quiz.question: Ta yaya dalibi zai iya amfani da AI?
options: Domin samar da tambayoyin gyara don shirya jarabawa
quiz.explanation: Dalibai na iya amfani da AI wajen shirya jarabawa ta hanyar samar da tambayoyin gyara.

quiz.question: Ta yaya dan kasuwa zai iya amfani da AI?
quiz.explanation: 'Yan kasuwa na iya amfani da AI don tsara jadawali ko rubuta bayanan kasuwanci.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata a yi kafin amincewa da amsar AI gaba ɗaya?
options: A duba amsar da kyau don tabbatarwa
A amince nan take ba tare da bincike ba
quiz.explanation: Ana bukatar tantance amsar AI kafin amfani da ita don muhimman abubuwa.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake amfani da AI don kara yawan aiki

lessons.title: Da'a a Amfani da AI (AI Ethics)
lessons.summary: Muhimman batutuwan da'a da suka shafi AI
lessons.content:
Yayin da AI ke kara yaduwa, akwai muhimman tambayoyi na da'a da suka taso: shin ana amfani da bayanan mutane ba tare da izininsu ba wajen horas da AI? Shin AI na iya nuna son zuciya ga wasu kabilu ko jinsi saboda bayanan da aka horas da ita? Shin ana iya amfani da AI wajen yada karya (misinformation) ko kirkirar hotuna/bidiyo na karya (deepfakes)?

Sanin wadannan tambayoyi yana taimaka mana zama masu amfani da AI cikin hankali - misali, ta hanyar tantance duk wani hoto ko bidiyo mai ban mamaki kafin mu yi imani da shi, kuma ta hanyar kula da yadda muke bayar da bayananmu ga kayan aikin AI.

quiz.question: Menene deepfake?
options: Hoto ko bidiyo na karya da AI ta kirkira
quiz.explanation: Deepfake shine hoto/bidiyo na karya da aka kirkira ta amfani da AI.

quiz.question: Me yasa AI za ta iya nuna son zuciya (bias)?
options: Saboda bayanan da aka horas da ita na iya kunshe da son zuciya
Domin AI tana da hankali kamar mutum
Domin AI mai kyauta ce koyaushe
quiz.explanation: Idan bayanan horaswa suna da son zuciya, AI ma za ta nuna irin wannan son zuciya.

quiz.question: Wace tambaya ce ta da'a game da bayanan mutane da AI?
options: Shin ana amfani da bayanan mutane ba tare da izininsu ba?
Wane launi ne AI take so?
quiz.explanation: Amfani da bayanan mutane ba tare da izini ba babbar tambaya ce ta da'a.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata mu yi idan mun ga hoto ko bidiyo mai ban mamaki akan layi?
options: Mu tantance shi kafin mu yi imani da shi
Mu yi imani da shi ba tare da tunani ba
quiz.explanation: Tantance abin da muke gani na iya hana yaduwar bayanan karya (deepfakes).

quiz.question: Me ya kamata mu kula da shi yayin amfani da kayan aikin AI?
options: Yadda muke bayar da bayananmu ga AI
quiz.explanation: Kula da bayanan da muke bayarwa yana kare sirrinmu.

diagram.caption: Muhimman batutuwan da'a da suka shafi AI

lessons.title: AI da Ayyukan Yi
lessons.summary: Yadda AI ke shafar ayyukan yi da yadda za a shirya
lessons.content:
AI na canza yadda ake yin aiki a fannoni da yawa - wasu ayyuka masu maimaici (repetitive) na iya raguwa saboda AI, amma sabbin ayyuka ma suna bulla, kamar 'prompt engineer' ko 'AI trainer'. Maimakon tsoron AI, hikima ita ce koyon yadda za a yi amfani da ita a matsayin kayan aiki don kara yawan aiki.

Mutanen da suka koyi amfani da AI cikin fasaha - misali, wajen tsara aiki, nazarin bayanai, ko sadarwa - suna samun fa'ida a kasuwar aiki fiye da wadanda ba su koya ba. Saboda haka, koyon amfani da AI a yau saka hannun jari ne ga makomarka.

quiz.question: Ta yaya AI ke shafar ayyukan yi?
options: Tana rage ayyuka masu maimaici amma tana kirkirar sabbin ayyuka
Tana kara ayyuka masu maimaici kadai
quiz.explanation: AI na iya rage bukatar wasu ayyuka amma tana kuma kirkirar sabbin ire-iren ayyuka.

quiz.question: Wanne sabon aiki ne ya bulla saboda AI?
quiz.explanation: Prompt engineer sabon aiki ne da ya bulla tare da yaduwar AI chatbots.

quiz.question: Wace hikima ce ta fi kyau game da AI da ayyukan yi?
options: Koyon amfani da AI a matsayin kayan aiki
Yin watsi da AI gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Koyon amfani da AI yana bunkasa damar samun kyakkyawan aiki.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce mutanen da suka koyi amfani da AI ke samu?
options: Fa'ida a kasuwar aiki fiye da wadanda ba su koya ba
quiz.explanation: Sanin amfani da AI yana kara wa mutum darajarsa a kasuwar aiki.

quiz.question: Me ake nufi da 'koyon AI saka hannun jari ne ga makomarka'?
options: Cewa lokacin da aka kashe wajen koyo yana da amfani na dogon lokaci
Cewa AI za ta biya ka kuɗi kai tsaye
Cewa AI za ta maye gurbin ka gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Kamar saka hannun jari, koyon fasaha yana bada fa'ida a nan gaba.

lessons.title: Neural Networks - Yadda Suke Aiki
lessons.summary: Asalin tsarin da ke tafiyar da yawancin AI ta yau
lessons.content:
Neural Network (cibiyar sadarwar jijiya ta wucin gadi) tsari ne na AI wanda aka gina domin kwaikwayon yadda ƙwaƙwalwar dan Adam ke aiki, ta amfani da 'nodes' ko 'neurons' da aka tsara a matakai (layers): Input layer (inda bayanai ke shiga), Hidden layers (inda ake sarrafa bayanan), da Output layer (inda amsa ke fitowa).

Kowane haɗi tsakanin nodes yana da 'weight' (nauyi) wanda ke canzawa yayin training domin inganta amsar da network din take bayarwa. Wannan tsari shine tushen fasahar 'Deep Learning' da ke bayan yawancin manyan nasarorin AI na baya-bayan nan, daga gane hoto zuwa fahimtar harshe.

diagram.caption: Danna kowane matakin (layer) domin ganin yadda bayanai ke gudana

quiz.question: Menene Neural Network?
options: Tsarin AI da aka gina domin kwaikwayon ƙwaƙwalwar dan Adam
quiz.explanation: Neural Network yana kwaikwayon yadda jijiyoyin ƙwaƙwalwa ke sadarwa da juna.

quiz.question: Wanne matakai uku ne suka hada Neural Network?
quiz.explanation: Neural Networks suna da Input layer, Hidden layers, da Output layer.

quiz.question: Menene 'weight' a Neural Network?
options: Nauyin da ke tsakanin nodes wanda ke canzawa yayin training
quiz.explanation: Weight yana nuna karfin hadin gwiwa tsakanin nodes, wanda training ke gyarawa.

quiz.question: Wanne fasaha ce ke ginu akan Neural Networks?
quiz.explanation: Deep Learning yana amfani da manyan Neural Networks masu matakai da yawa.

quiz.question: A ina bayanai ke shiga Neural Network?
quiz.explanation: Input layer shine inda bayanai ke shiga kafin a sarrafa su.

lessons.title: Manyan Samfuran Harshe (Large Language Models)
lessons.summary: Yadda AI kamar ChatGPT da Claude ke gina jimloli
lessons.content:
Large Language Models (LLMs) kamar GPT da Claude an horas da su akan adadin rubutu mai yawan gaske daga intanet, littattafai, da sauran tushe. An gina su akan tsarin da ake kira 'Transformer', wanda ke bawa AI damar duba dukkan kalmomin da suka gabata a wani jumla domin fahimtar mahallin (context) kafin ta zabi kalma ta gaba.

A maimakon fahimtar ma'ana kamar mutum, LLM tana hasashen kalma ta gaba mafi dacewa bisa dubban misalai da ta gani a lokacin training. Wannan shine dalilin da ya sa wani lokaci take iya kuskure ko 'hallucinate' - tana zaben kalmomi masu ma'ana amma ba koyaushe daidai da gaskiya ba.

quiz.question: Menene LLM (Large Language Model)?
options: AI da aka horas da ita akan adadin rubutu mai yawa
quiz.explanation: LLM AI ce da aka horas da ita akan babban adadin rubutu domin fahimta da samar da harshe.

quiz.question: Wanne tsari ne LLMs suka ginu a kai?
quiz.explanation: Transformer shine tsarin da ke bawa LLMs damar duba mahallin jimla.

quiz.question: Ta yaya LLM ke zaban kalma ta gaba a jumla?
options: Ta hanyar hasashen kalma mafi dacewa bisa abin da ta koya
Ta hanyar kiran mutum ya taimaka
quiz.explanation: LLM tana hasashen kalma ta gaba bisa alaka da ta koya daga bayanai masu yawa.

quiz.question: Me yasa LLM za ta iya 'hallucinate'?
options: Domin tana zaben kalmomi masu ma'ana amma ba koyaushe daidai da gaskiya ba
Domin tana da hankali kamar mutum
Domin ba ta da wani tsari
quiz.explanation: LLM na iya samar da amsa mai ma'ana amma marar gaskiya idan ba ta da tabbataccen bayani.

quiz.question: A kan me aka horas da LLMs?
options: Adadin rubutu mai yawa daga intanet da littattafai
quiz.explanation: LLMs suna koyo daga rubutu mai yawan gaske.

lessons.title: Generative AI - Kirkirar Hoto, Bidiyo, da Rubutu
lessons.summary: Yadda AI ke kirkirar sabon abu maimakon nazari kawai
lessons.content:
Generative AI wani nau'in AI ne da ke iya kirkirar sabon abu - rubutu, hoto, bidiyo, ko sauti - maimakon kawai nazari ko rarraba bayanai. Misalai sun hada da DALL-E da Midjourney (kirkirar hoto daga rubutu), da kuma ChatGPT da Claude (kirkirar rubutu).

Wadannan samfuran suna amfani da tsari da ake kira 'diffusion' (ga hotuna) ko 'transformer' (ga rubutu) domin gina sabon abu daga karce, bisa abin da suka koya daga miliyoyin misalai. Wannan fasaha tana bude sabbin damammaki na kirkira, amma tana kuma dagula tambayoyin mallakar fasaha (copyright) da amincin abin da ake gani akan layi.

quiz.question: Menene Generative AI?
options: AI da ke kirkirar sabon abu kamar rubutu, hoto, ko bidiyo
AI da ke nazarin bayanai kawai
quiz.explanation: Generative AI tana kirkirar sabon abu maimakon nazari kawai.

quiz.question: Wanne kayan aiki ne misali na kirkirar hoto daga rubutu?
quiz.explanation: DALL-E da Midjourney sanannun kayan aikin kirkirar hoto ne ta amfani da AI.

quiz.question: Wanne tsari ne ake amfani da shi wajen kirkirar hoto a Generative AI?
quiz.explanation: Diffusion tsari ne da ake amfani da shi domin kirkirar hoto daga karce.

quiz.question: Wace tambaya ce Generative AI ke dagulawa?
options: Mallakar fasaha (copyright) da amincin abin da ake gani
quiz.explanation: Kirkirar sabon abu ta AI na kawo tambayoyi kan mallaka da gaskiyar abin da ake gani.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na Generative AI ta rubutu?
quiz.explanation: ChatGPT da Claude misalai ne na Generative AI da ke kirkirar rubutu.

lessons.title: Fine-tuning da RAG
lessons.summary: Yadda ake keɓance AI don takamaiman aiki
lessons.content:
Fine-tuning shine tsarin daukar samfurin AI da aka riga aka horas da shi (pretrained model) sannan a kara horas da shi akan karin bayanai na musamman, domin ya kware a wani fanni ko aiki na musamman - misali, kamfanin banki na iya yin fine-tuning ga AI domin ta fahimci kalmomin fasaha na banki sosai.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) wata dabara ce daban: maimakon canza AI din kanta, ana bata damar neman bayanai daga wata database ta musamman (misali, takardun kamfani) kafin ta amsa tambaya. Wannan yana taimaka wa AI bada amsoshi masu tushe da sabo, maimakon dogaro da abin da ta koya lokacin training kadai.

quiz.question: Menene fine-tuning?
options: Kara horas da samfurin AI akan bayanai na musamman domin ya kware a wani fanni
quiz.explanation: Fine-tuning yana kara horas da AI akan bayanai na musamman.

quiz.question: Menene RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)?
options: Bawa AI damar neman bayanai daga database kafin amsa tambaya
quiz.explanation: RAG yana bawa AI damar amfani da bayanai na waje maimakon dogaro da abin da ta koya kawai.

quiz.question: Ta yaya RAG ke taimaka wa AI?
options: Tana bada amsoshi masu tushe da sabo daga bayanan da aka nema
quiz.explanation: RAG tana taimaka wa AI samun bayanai na yanzu ko na musamman kafin bada amsa.

quiz.question: Wanne kamfani zai iya amfana da fine-tuning?
options: Kamfanin banki da ke son AI ta fahimci kalmomin fasahar banki
Kowane mutum ba tare da wata bukata ba
quiz.explanation: Fine-tuning yana da amfani ga kamfanoni masu bukatar AI mai kware a wani fanni na musamman.

quiz.question: Menene bambanci tsakanin fine-tuning da RAG?
options: Fine-tuning yana canza AI din kanta, RAG yana kara mata bayanai na waje
quiz.explanation: Fine-tuning yana canza AI din, yayin da RAG ke kara mata damar neman bayanai a lokacin amsawa.

lessons.title: AI Agents - AI da Ke Yin Ayyuka Da Kanta
lessons.summary: Yadda AI za ta iya daukar mataki, ba kawai amsa tambaya ba
lessons.content:
AI Agent wani tsari ne na AI wanda ba kawai yake amsa tambaya ba, har ma yana iya daukar matakai da kansa domin cimma wata manufa - misali, neman bayani a intanet, rubuta lambar kwamfuta (code), ko yin odar wani abu, duk ba tare da mutum ya bayar da umarni a kowane mataki ba.

Wannan ya sha bamban da chatbot na yau da kullum wanda ke jira tambaya kafin ya amsa. AI Agent na iya tsara matakai da kansa, aiwatar da su, sannan ya duba sakamakon domin ganin ko ya cimma manufa, kafin ya ci gaba ko ya gyara hanyar da yake bi.

quiz.question: Menene AI Agent?
options: AI da ke iya daukar matakai da kanta domin cimma manufa
Chatbot na yau da kullum kawai
quiz.explanation: AI Agent yana daukar matakai da kansa, ba kawai amsa tambaya ba.

quiz.question: Ta yaya AI Agent ya sha bamban da chatbot na yau da kullum?
options: Yana iya tsarawa da aiwatar da matakai da kansa
Chatbot yana da ƙarfi fiye da Agent
AI Agent ba ya iya yin komai
quiz.explanation: AI Agent na iya daukar matakai da kansa maimakon jira tambaya kadai.

quiz.question: Wanne aiki ne AI Agent za ta iya yi da kanta?
options: Neman bayani a intanet ko rubuta lambar kwamfuta
quiz.explanation: AI Agent na iya aiwatar da ayyuka kamar bincike ko rubuta code ba tare da umarni a kowane mataki ba.

quiz.question: Me AI Agent ke yi bayan ya aiwatar da wani mataki?
options: Yana duba sakamakon domin ganin ko ya cimma manufa
Yana tsayawa nan take ba tare da bincike ba
quiz.explanation: AI Agent yana bincika sakamakon domin tantance ko ya cimma manufa ko yana bukatar gyara.

quiz.question: Wanne mataki ne AI Agent zai iya yi da kansa idan matakin farko bai yi nasara ba?
options: Ya gyara hanyar da yake bi ya sake gwadawa
quiz.explanation: AI Agent na iya sake tsarawa da gyara hanyarsa idan mataki na farko bai yi nasara ba.

lessons.title: Gina Sana'a a Fannin AI
lessons.summary: Hanyoyin fara sana'a a fannin hankalin wucin gadi
lessons.content:
Akwai hanyoyi da yawa na shiga fannin AI, ko da ba ka da tushen ilimin injiniya. 'Prompt Engineer' misali ne na sana'a wadda ke bukatar fahimtar yadda ake tsara tambayoyi masu kyau ga AI don kamfanoni. 'AI Product Manager' yana bukatar fahimtar yadda ake amfani da AI wajen gina kayayyakin da za su taimaka wa mutane, ba tare da bukatar zama injiniya ba.

Ga wadanda ke son zurfafa a fannin fasaha, 'Machine Learning Engineer' da 'Data Scientist' sana'o'i ne masu bukatar ilimin lissafi da shirye-shirye (programming). Mafarin da ya fi kyau shine koyon amfani da kayan aikin AI da ke akwai a yau, sannan a zabi wani fanni na musamman bisa sha'awa da fasahar da kake da ita.

quiz.question: Wace sana'a ce ke bukatar fahimtar yadda ake tsara tambayoyi masu kyau ga AI?
quiz.explanation: Prompt Engineer sana'a ce da ke bukatar fasahar tsara tambayoyi ga AI.

quiz.question: Shin dole ne ka zama injiniya kafin ka shiga fannin AI?
options: A'a, akwai hanyoyi da yawa ko da ba ka da tushen injiniya
Ba za a iya shiga fannin ba kwata-kwata
quiz.explanation: Akwai sana'o'i kamar AI Product Manager wadanda ba sa bukatar zama injiniya.

quiz.question: Wace sana'a ce ke bukatar ilimin lissafi da shirye-shirye?
options: Machine Learning Engineer ko Data Scientist
quiz.explanation: ML Engineer da Data Scientist na bukatar zurfin ilimin lissafi da programming.

quiz.question: Menene mafarin da ya fi kyau don shiga fannin AI?
options: Koyon amfani da kayan aikin AI da ke akwai a yau
Jira har a gama koyon komai kafin a fara
quiz.explanation: Fara da amfani da kayan aikin AI da ke akwai yana bude fahimta mai zurfi a hankali.

quiz.question: Wanne abu biyu ne za su taimaka wajen zaban wani fanni na musamman a AI?
options: Sha'awa da fasahar da kake da ita
quiz.explanation: Zaban fanni na musamman ya kamata ya dogara da sha'awa da fasahar da mutum ke da ita.
